faq.question: Is there a casino at the hotel?
faq.answer: No, Simplotel Grand does not have a casino.

faq.question: Is the hotel wheelchair accessible?
faq.answer: Yes, the hotel is fully wheelchair accessible with ramps, accessible rooms, and elevators throughout the property.

faq.question: Can I store my luggage after check-out?
faq.answer: Yes, complimentary luggage storage is available at the bell desk for the day of check-out.

faq.question: Do you arrange weddings or events?
faq.answer: Yes, we have a grand ballroom (capacity 500) and two smaller banquet halls. Contact our events team at events@grandhorizon.in for packages.

faq.question: Is there a doctor on call?
faq.answer: Yes, a doctor is available on call 24/7. Please contact the front desk in case of a medical emergency.
